sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('hikma berkeley heights', 'eugia specialities', 'hikma', 'doc rx', 'eugia') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%dexamethasone%' ORDER BY initiation_date
